scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/api/dist packages/storage/dist packages/core/dist && rm -rf packages/api/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/storage/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/core/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm -r --filter=./packages/api build && pnpm -r --filter=./packages/storage build && pnpm -r --filter=./packages/core build && pnpm run prepare-publish
scripts.publish:nexus3: pnpm run publish:api && pnpm run publish:core && pnpm run publish:storage
scripts.prepare-publish: mkdir -p dist && cp -r packages/api/dist dist/api && cp -r packages/core/dist dist/core && cp -r packages/storage/dist dist/storage && echo 'Successfully prepared dist directory' || (echo 'Failed to prepare dist directory' && exit 1)
scripts.release:all: pnpm run release && pnpm run release:api && pnpm run release:core && pnpm run release:storage
